design: One development run per case/backend/condition; independent generations, no fixed model seed, no human ratings. The verbose draft was superseded after two mock context-budget regressions, not musical preference. All draft trials are retained. No real Ollama inference or external audio critic.
limitations: The isolated GPUI fixture exposes no installed voices. Panel vocal WAVs contain either a guide or a muted singer, not VOICEVOX.
Final and baseline vocal scores are separately synthesized using the same installed VOICEVOX 0.26.0 speaker and seed. This does not establish agent synthesis completion.
Metrics describe completion and signal properties, not musical preference. One run does not establish a quality or reliability improvement.
